description:
Dynamic and results-driven education counsellor specializing in MBA admissions, with a strong focus on guiding students from Maharashtra towards top colleges across India. Backed by a year of hands-on experience and having completed my MBA from SCMHRD Pune, I excel at helping aspirants discover, evaluate, and secure admission in management programs that best match their academic goals and career ambitions. My counselling approach combines up-to-date knowledge of entrance exams, college selection, and application processes with personalized support—ensuring students make informed decisions at every step.

With expertise in the Indian MBA landscape and a thorough understanding of the challenges faced by local students, I provide tailored guidance, from college comparisons to entrance preparation strategy, directly addressing each candidate’s unique needs. Dedicated, approachable, and passionate about student success, I strive to empower my clients to unlock their full potential in India's competitive management education environment.
